name: SN2 Reaction
review_notes: SN2 electron flow and Walden inversion are textbook-standard. Confirm CIP labels (S)-2-bromobutane → (R)-butan-2-ol against the drawn wedges before marking verified.

steps.title: Backside nucleophilic attack with simultaneous C–Br cleavage
steps.description: Hydroxide donates a lone pair into the C–Br σ* orbital from 180° opposite bromine. The C–Br bonding pair departs onto bromine in the same concerted step.

steps.title: Trigonal bipyramidal transition state
steps.description: Pentacoordinate carbon with collinear HO···C···Br. Methyl, hydrogen, and ethyl occupy the equatorial plane. This is a transition state, not a discrete intermediate.

steps.title: Walden inversion — (R)-butan-2-ol
steps.description: The nucleophile is fully bonded. Configuration at C2 is inverted relative to the starting alkyl bromide. Bromide is the leaving-group product.
